purpose: Teach: 燃やし/とうてい/しかるべき/思い通り/のべ/いちおう/かならず/みごと

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お庭の落ち葉を燃やしたいわね
lines.en: Sho, the garden leaves have been piling up — we should burn them off today.
lines.style: Calm, practical statement delivered while thinking through the afternoon's tasks. Matter-of-fact tone, slightly warm. A gentle suggestion wrapped in routine.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ピアノはとうてい上手に弾けないよ
lines.en: Mom, I can't really play the piano well though.
lines.style: Small, hesitant voice. Not complaining — more like he's pointing out a thing he's noticed about himself. Quiet certainty underneath. A pause before 'well' like he's being honest.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、悪い事をしたら、しかるべき罰を受けましょうね
lines.en: Sho, when we do something wrong, we accept the consequence that comes with it — don't we.
lines.style: Steady, measured tone. This is a teaching moment but not a scolding. Gentle firmness. The slight lift at the end inviting agreement, not demanding it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、思い通りに絵が描けなかったよ
lines.en: Mom, I couldn't draw the picture the way I wanted to.
lines.style: Quiet disappointment. He's not looking for comfort, just naming the fact. Small, even delivery. The kind of moment where a child trusts you enough to admit frustration without dramatizing it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、おやつの量はのべ三回までよ
lines.en: Sho, you can have snacks three times today — that's the rule.
lines.style: Clear, consistent rule stated without edge. Warm but unbendable. The tone of someone who's made this decision fairly and knows he'll remember it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、いちおう宿題は終わったよ
lines.en: Mom, I finished my homework anyway — even though it was hard.
lines.style: Small pride underneath. He's not showing off — he's reporting something real he did. Soft but steady. A little hope in there that she'll notice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはかならず7時に帰っていらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father will definitely be home by seven.
lines.style: Reassuring statement, almost to herself. Calm certainty. The rhythm of something she's said before and means every time.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんのお話、みごとに覚えたよ
lines.en: Mom, I remembered Grandpa's whole story — the whole thing!
lines.style: Bright, genuine excitement. Not loud, but luminous. The pride of small hands holding onto something precious. Soft warmth. A child who's earned this moment.
